title: Tycho Brahe & Johannes Kepler (1546–1601 / 1571–1630) — The Brass Nose, Uraniborg's Island Kingdom, Eight Arcminutes of Mars, and the Stolen Ledgers

teenKit.tldr: An arrogant Danish aristocrat with a brass prosthetic nose and a broke, half-blind German math genius teamed up to map the stars, resulting in a tiny 8-arcminute math mismatch that shattered 2,000 years of astronomical dogmas.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Without Kepler ruthlessly chasing an 8-arcminute error instead of ignoring it, we would not understand orbital mechanics, meaning modern satellite communication, GPS navigation, and space exploration would be utterly impossible.
keyTakeaways: Tycho Brahe built Uraniborg, an absurdly expensive island research complex funded by bleeding over one percent of Denmark's national revenue.
Scientific breakthroughs in the 16th and 17th centuries relied entirely on volatile political patronage and surviving the whims of unpredictable monarchs.
Johannes Kepler proved that planetary orbits are ellipses, not perfect circles, because he refused to fake a minuscule eight-arcminute discrepancy in Mars's data.

vocab.meaning: The brass and gold-alloy facial replacement Tycho Brahe wore after losing his real nose in a drunken math duel.

options: A brutal sword duel fought in the dark over a mathematical disagreement

quiz.explanation: Tycho fought a pitch-dark sword duel against his cousin over a math dispute, resulting in the loss of his nose.

quiz.question: Why was the famous 'eight-arcminute' discrepancy regarding Mars so crucial to Johannes Kepler?
options: It proved that Tycho Brahe had stolen data from rival Italian astronomers
It forced Kepler to abandon circular orbits and discover that planets move in ellipses
It showed that Mars was slowly drifting out of the solar system entirely
It was the exact margin of error needed to win a royal cash prize in Prague
quiz.explanation: That tiny mismatch was too big to ignore, forcing Kepler to throw out 2,000 years of circular orbit dogma.

quiz.question: How did Tycho Brahe manage to fund his massive island observatory kingdom, Uraniborg?
options: By patenting early telescopes and selling navigational charts to merchants
By winning massive cash payouts from European university competitions
By consuming over one percent of Denmark's total national revenue through royal grants
By inheriting a vast merchant shipping empire across the Baltic Sea
quiz.explanation: Tycho leveraged his aristocratic status to secure a massive slice of the Danish national budget for his mega-science island.
